assertion: An event exists, described as "Hurricane Lala impacts Big Island".
judge_quote: One person was killed in a storm-related car crash as Hurricane Lala brought fierce winds and pouring rain to Hawaii’s Big Island on Saturday.
evidence_cited: One person was killed in a storm-related car crash as Hurricane Lala brought fierce winds and pouring rain to Hawaii’s Big Island on Saturday.
Footage on social media showed floodwaters rising, overtaking roadways and bridges as Lala dumped rain on Hawaii’s Big Island.
According to the National Weather Service’s Honolulu office, two homes were swept away due to intense rainfall over Naalehu, with flash flooding ongoing.
Maximum sustained winds near 75 mph with higher gusts were recorded as the storm advanced.
Forecasters said higher elevations on the island, dominated by the towering Mauna Kea volcano, could get as much as 25 inches of rain.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Power outages on Big Island".
judge_quote: More than 125,000 utility customers in the state, mostly on the Big Island, were without electricity, according to utility tracker PowerOutage.us.
evidence_cited: More than 125,000 utility customers in the state, mostly on the Big Island, were without electricity, according to utility tracker PowerOutage.us.
Electricity was knocked out for 10% of customers on the Big Island, according to poweroutage.us.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Search and rescue in Alihu and Waiheno".
judge_quote: Hawaii County Mayor Kimo Alameda said in an Instagram post that “several occupied homes may have been swept off their foundations” amid flash flooding in the Alihu and Waiheno areas, with a search and rescue mission underway.
evidence_cited: Hawaii County Mayor Kimo Alameda said in an Instagram post that 'several occupied homes may have been swept off their foundations' amid flash flooding in the Alihu and Waiheno areas, with a search and rescue mission underway.
Honolulu Mayor Rick Blangiardi said at a news conference that search and rescue crews were working in dire conditions at Oahu’s Lulumahu Falls Trail to find a hiker.
Honolulu Ocean Safety Department Director Kurt Lager said lifeguards made 59 rescues Saturday.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Governor Green warns of worsening conditions".
judge_quote: “Hurricane Lala is passing just south of Hawaiʻi Island, where winds are peaking and some areas have already received more than 13 inches of rain,” Gov. Josh Green said on X. “Conditions are worsening across Maui County, Oʻahu and Kaua‘i tonight.”
evidence_cited: Gov. Josh Green said on X. 'Conditions are worsening across Maui County, Oʻahu and Kaua‘i tonight.'
Green described it as an 'enormous storm' and warned of destructive flooding and even the possibility of wildfires kicked up by strong winds across the island chain.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Director Lager issues safety warnings".
